task_name: World 133 Task A  -  S-Corp Personal Card Commingling, Unsubstantiated Cash Withdrawals & >2% Shareholder Health Insurance
prompt: Review the October 2026 chart of accounts, shareholder ownership and W-2 schedule, and checking and corporate Amex ledger for Crestline Specialty Contracting Inc. in scorp_oct2026_owner_draws_personal_card_and_equity.xlsx. Identify all personal shareholder charges and unreceipted cash withdrawals improperly buried in COGS and operating expenses (separating documented jobsite expenses), audit the >2% S-corporation shareholder health insurance postings in 6135 Employee Health Benefits, and reconcile October 2026 COGS, operating expenses, and Net Income.

rubric.description: Identifies $18,200.00 of personal Corporate Amex charges by 60% Shareholder A (AMEX-401 $11,400.00 residential kitchen cabinets in 5210, AMEX-404 $4,850.00 family Hawaii trip in 6410, and AMEX-409 $1,950.00 country club dues in 6420) plus $6,000.00 of unsubstantiated cash withdrawals (CHK-WDR-01 $3,500.00 and CHK-WDR-02 $2,500.00 in 6290), totaling $24,200.00 for Shareholder A.

Identifies AMEX-412 ($3,800.00 personal luxury watch in 6450 Promotional Gifts) as personal spend by 40% Shareholder B while retaining AMEX-415 ($2,400.00 FallTech OSHA roof harnesses delivered to Job #26-44) in 5210 Job Materials COGS.

Computes total disguised personal spend removed from COGS and operating expenses as $28,000.00 ($24,200.00 Shareholder A + $3,800.00 Shareholder B), reducing 5210 Job Materials COGS from $68,400.00 to $57,000.00.

Reconciles audited expense sub-accounts after personal-spend removal to $3,200.00 in 6290 Shop Supplies, $1,300.00 in 6410 Business Travel, $800.00 in 6420 Client Meals, and $500.00 in 6450 Promotional Gifts.

Identifies $3,500.00 of >2% S-corporation shareholder medical premiums (ACH-MED-A $2,100.00 for 60% Shareholder A and ACH-MED-B $1,400.00 for 40% Shareholder B) improperly posted to tax-free 6135 Employee Health Benefits alongside $5,400.00 of non-owner crew medical.
Reclassifies Dr 6115 Officer >2% Health Insurance $3,500.00 / Cr 6135 Employee Health Benefits $3,500.00 (leaving $5,400.00 in 6135 and $0.00 net P&L change).

Flags a mandatory payroll compliance hold requiring the >2% shareholder health insurance premiums ($2,100.00 SH-A and $1,400.00 SH-B) to be included in W-2 Box 1 wages (and Box 14) before year-end under IRC Section 162(l) and IRS Notice 2008-1 to preserve corporate deductibility.

Reconciles October 2026 total COGS and operating expenses from $157,000.00 unadjusted to $129,000.00 audited (-$28,000.00) and October 2026 Net Income from $38,000.00 unadjusted to $66,000.00 audited on $195,000.00 revenue.
